run_build_metadata: run the script to build a metadata JSON file from wordnet, wiki unigrams, bigrams, and titles
create_wordnet_synsets: create a list of wordnet synset names by extracting and cleaning all synset entries
create_wiki_unigram: create a list of wiki unigram words that appear at least a threshold number of times
create_wiki_bigrams: create a list of wiki bigram collocations filtered by pointwise mutual information threshold
create_wiki_title: create a list of popular wiki page titles by downloading and aggregating pageview data
